subject.title: feat: allow standalone MCP Apps to use bound tools and resources

question: Should the ticketed standalone MCP App host gain owning-server tool and resource authority now, rather than remain read-only until a later channel-launch product surface is approved?
rationale: The patch implements a new privileged browser capability and the linked issue is explicitly awaiting maintainer product and security judgment; correctness alone cannot decide whether that capability belongs in the current standalone-host scope.

options.title: Sponsor the scoped bridge
options.body: Approve the owner-server-only bridge after a focused security review and exact-head proof confirm the existing view-bound operation contract is preserved.

options.title: Keep the host read-only
options.body: Defer interactive standalone behavior until the channel-launch or approvals product direction is settled, retaining the existing ticketed renderer.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the scoped bridge
recommendation.body: Approve the owner-server-only bridge after a focused security review and exact-head proof confirm the existing view-bound operation contract is preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked design and implementation and can provide the intended capability and threat-model rationale to the reviewing owners.
